subject: Mutual Plan: PulseMetrics POC — Kickstart & Owners
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Brown <alyssa@pulsemetrics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Plan: PulseMetrics POC — Kickstart & Owners

Hi Alyssa / team,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to kick off the POC. I put together a working mutual action plan (attached) to make the evaluation scoped, timeboxed, and attributable. High-level items below; please review and flag anything missing.

Goal (what success looks like)
- Automated clinical-note parsing flow with 95% intent classification F1 on our benchmark set AND inference P95 latency <200ms in your staging environment at 1 RPS profile.
- Cost estimate: end-to-end inference unit economics under $0.30 per 1k requests at expected load (see bench spec).

Proposed owners
- Redwood AM / project lead: Priyom Das (I will own MAP coordination and weekly syncs)
- Benchmark & prompt steward: Laura Bennett (defines bench prompts, evaluation harness)
- Rerun / infra & quantization lead: Rishi Malhotra (deployment variants, performance tuning)
- Customer data / biz liaison: Alyssa (PulseMetrics)

Timeline (six weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP, share dataset slices and access, agree on bench set (owner: Laura)
- Week 1–2: initial prompt set + baseline runs (Redwood + PulseMetrics)
- Week 3: optimization: batching / KV caching / quantization experiments (Rishi)
- Week 4: stability and regression checks; cross-compare outputs with business cases (Laura + Alyssa)
- Week 5: executive readout and decision window (go/no-go)

Immediate asks
1) Alyssa — can you confirm who on your side will own dataset extraction and share a small sample (50–100 records) for bench prep by EOD Friday?
2) Laura / Rishi — please review the attached MAP template and bench spec and add owners/dates by close of day Thursday.
3) I will send an invite for Weekly MAP standups (30 min) — preferred cadence Tuesdays 10am PT unless you tell me otherwise.

Attachments: PulseMetrics_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP template), eval_bench_spec.md (bench definitions + metrics)

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth run.

—
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Alyssa Brown <alyssa@pulsemetrics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@pulsesys.com>, CISO (PulseMetrics) <security@pulsemetrics.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan: PulseMetrics POC — Kickstart & Owners

Thanks Priyom — the plan looks sensible and gives us the clarity we need. Quick answers and some asks from our side: 

- Dataset owner: Daniel Hsu (cc'd) will own extracting the sample. Daniel, can you share a 50-record anonymized CSV by COB Thursday PST?
- Security ask: our CISO would like to validate the data handling notes in your MAP (especially data retention and logs). Can you confirm: where will logs live during the POC and who will have access?
- Bench metric: we can agree on F1 & p95 latency, but we also need a qualitative pass rate for hallucination on clinical entities — can that be added to the bench spec?

We confirm Alyssa/PM leadership will take acceptance decision at the Week 5 readout. Looking forward to the calendar invite.

Best,
Alyssa Brown
Head of Product | PulseMetrics
alyssa@pulsemetrics.com

Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan: PulseMetrics POC — Kickstart & Owners

Thanks Priyom / Alyssa — I reviewed the MAP and bench spec. I added a short appendix in eval_bench_spec.md for the hallucination qualitative pass: 3 raters, 30 samples, binary pass/fail on entity-level hallucination.

Quick owner notes (internal):
- I will take point on bench creation and will upload the initial prompt set to the Drive link Priyom shared by Thursday 5pm PT.
- Tessa: can you run the baseline harness on Redwood hosted model variant A and push results to the shared folder? If yes, target Monday EOD for the first run.
- Rishi: please reserve a test runner (small Dedicated node) for the perf experiments in Week 3 — ping me if you need specific sequence-length distributions.

I'll also add a short acceptance rubric for the Week 5 readout (pass/fail + recommended tuning steps if not met).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior ML Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Brown <alyssa@pulsemetrics.com>, Daniel Hsu <daniel.hsu@pulsesys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Plan: PulseMetrics POC — Kickstart & Owners

Perfect — thanks for the fast turnaround. Two quick follow-ups: 
1) Daniel — if you can drop the sample in the Drive folder (link below) I will confirm receipt and hand to Laura for bench prep.
2) Security: Rishi I looped you to provide a brief note (1–2 bullets) on where POC logs/keys live and retention policy for the CISO. Can we have that by EOD today so Alyssa can share with security?

I created the weekly MAP calendar invite (attached) for Tuesdays 10am PT starting next week; please accept or propose.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PulseMap

Attachments: MAP_Calendar.ics

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting started.

Priyom
